SELECT c.drink_category_id AS categoryId, c.shop_id AS shopId, c.category_name AS categoryName, s.shop_name AS shopName FROM drink_categories c LEFT JOIN shops s ON c.shop_id = s.shop_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY
c.category_name c.shop_id c.drink_category_id
DESC ASC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
